scope.index_rule: same named rule for index and candidates

components.distance: 0 for identical declared age band; 1 otherwise
components.missing: omit from observed weighted distance and reduce coverage; top-coded age is not exact age

components.selector: minimum eligible pre-index value within 48 elapsed hours

components.distance: 1 minus Jaccard similarity on selected pre-index concept sets after versioned reviewed ancestor expansion
components.empty_sets: missing component unless source coverage explicitly establishes observed empty sets; two observed empty sets have distance 0

aggregation.observed_distance: sum(w_i*d_i for observed pairs) / sum(w_i for observed pairs)
aggregation.coverage: sum(w_i for observed pairs) / sum(w_i for all configured components)
aggregation.score_semantics: demonstration preference score; neither relaxation cost nor clinical probability

promotion: promoting a component to hard eligibility creates a new revision with an explicit predicate; this is not a weight change
